articles.headline: NBA championship and Finals MVP odds: Thunder remain title favorites heading into Game 7 vs. Spurs
articles.description: Game 7 is set for Saturday in Oklahoma City, with the Thunder-Spurs winner playing the Eastern Conference champion Knicks in the NBA Finals.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [1296x729]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama are Nos. 1 and 2 in the Finals MVP odds, respectively.

images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder are back to being odds-on title favorites after taking a 3-2 series lead over the Spurs.

images.caption: The Knicks are now heavy favorites to win the Eastern Conference after taking a 3-0 series lead over the Cavs.

article.headline: Bradley Beal leads with 25 points off the bench, Suns pull away late to beat the Hawks 123-115
article.description: — Bradley Beal scored 25 points, Kevin Durant added 23 and the Phoenix Suns beat the Atlanta Hawks 123-115 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Bradley Beal leads with 25 points off the bench, Suns pull away late to beat the Hawks 123-115

images.name: Atlanta Hawks vs. Phoenix Suns: Game Highlights
images.caption: Atlanta Hawks vs. Phoenix Suns: Game Highlights

article.story: PHOENIX -- — Bradley Beal scored 25 points, Kevin Durant added 23 and the Phoenix Suns beat the Atlanta Hawks 123-115 on Thursday night. Beal — still adjusting to his new role coming off the bench — shot 11 of 16 from the field in one of his most efficient games this season. Devin Booker added 20 points and 12 assists despite shooting 0 of 8 from 3-point range. Beal made a driving layup just before the third quarter buzzer to give the Suns a 98-92 lead heading into the fourth. Grayson Allen, who scored 23, hit his fifth 3-pointer to give the Suns a 120-105 lead with 3:26 left. The Hawks scored the next 10 points but Allen sealed it with a tough layup in traffic with 36 seconds left. Trae Young led the Hawks with 21 points and seven assists. Seven Atlanta players scored in double figures. The Suns took a 38-31 lead in the first quarter after shooting 75% from the field, but the Hawks rallied with their own hot-shooting quarter to take a 72-68 advantage by halftime. Takeaways Hawks: Atlanta falls back to .500 for the season after struggling to stop the Suns' offense. The Hawks — who have dropped four of their last five games — missed forward Jalen Johnson, who missed a third straight game with right shoulder inflammation. Suns: Phoenix has won two of its past three as it tries to shake a slump that's lasted nearly two months. The Suns have a lot of work to do, but now that their Big 3 are healthy, they have a chance to gain some momentum. Key moment Durant, Tyus Jones and Allen hit three straight 3s to give the Suns a 120-105 lead with 4:03 left. Key stat The Suns shot 57.6% from the field. Up next Hawks host Rockets on Saturday; Jazz host Suns on Saturday. ------ AP NBA: https://apnews.com/NBA
